thread:
Sam Patel: Quick sync — for next sprint we need a concise plan for field validation on new catalog entries + a clear pin rollback flow for customer-pinned models. Goal: reduce surprise migrations and make rollbacks automatic when safe.
Kevin Liu: sounds good. I'll draft a short checklist for metadata schema, required bench artifacts, and risk flags.
Jess Reyes: runtime note — validation should accept missing quant profiles but mark as 'soft-fail' and prevent auto-pinning. Hard fail only if model binary checksum mismatch or license mismatch.
Maria Gomez: Bench proposal: run the eval harness (answer-quality-scorer) on a 200-sample canonical set + latency sampling. We gate on quality delta <= 1% and p95 latency <= baseline * 1.2.
Nina Singh: Customer ops ask — customers with explicit pins need a rollback TTL and opt-in for auto-fallback. We should add a notification window (7 days) before forced unpin/migration.
Sam Patel: Proposal: onboarding gates = schema pass + bench artifacts present + one canary pass. Pin policy: defaults to 30-day pin window; customers can opt for exceptions. Rollback triggers: repeated canary failures (3/5), or production error rate delta > 200% for 10m.
Kevin Liu: I'll add a small state machine for pins in the catalog: states = [unpinned, soft-pinned, pinned, rollback-pending, rolled-back]. Add metadata fields: `pin_expires_at`, `pin_reason`, `pin_owner`, `pin_rollback_window`.
Jess Reyes: runtime needs to expose canary traffic percent and health signals: `canary_errors`, `canary_latency_p95`, `quality_regression_score`. We'll wire alerts: `catalog.pin.slo_breach` and `catalog.pin.canary_fail`.
Maria Gomez: Also recommend storing the bench snapshot artifacts (seeded prompts + outputs) as part of the catalog entry for future regressions. Useful for automatic reruns.
Nina Singh: Comms: customers get a staging notice 7 days prior, then 24h reminder before rollback. Support templates ready? I can draft.
Sam Patel: Quick config example for product/ops (WIP):
```
{
  "pin_policy": {
    "default_ttl_days": 30,
    "auto_rollback_triggers": {"canary_failures": 3, "error_rate_pct": 200},
    "notification_window_days": 7
  },
  "validation": {
    "required_fields": ["model_id","license","bench_artifact_url"],
    "soft_fail_fields": ["quant_profile"]
  }
}
```
Kevin Liu: Nice. I'll add this to the migration runbook and include a minimal rollback script stub.
Jess Reyes: Runtime ops item — add a lightweight endpoint to force `pin_state=rollback-pending` for manual mitigations and an automated backoff for retries.
Maria Gomez: For gating metrics, let's use existing eval suites and a single composite quality metric we can compute automatically. I'll surface thresholds in the ticket.
Sam Patel: Action items: Kevin = runbook + state machine, Jess = runtime telemetry + force-endpoint, Maria = bench artifact contract + thresholds, Nina = customer comms templates. I'll own merging the config into onboarding docs.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout for catalog item `redwood/open-latency-v1` at 2026-04-05T10:00Z (canary 5% traffic).
Nina Singh: :thumbsup: I'll prep comms for that model.
Kevin Liu: Ack. Will post runbook link once done.
Sam Patel: Thanks all — moving this to the sprint board under "catalog lifecycle - pin & rollback". Ping here if anything blocks.
